name_input: BILI HU COFFEES LLP; BILI HU COFFEES LLP
export_evidence: No export record with date, destination, HS code or B/L number was retrievable. ImportKey pages for both slug variants (https://importkey.com/countries/india/bili-hu-coffees-llp and .../bili-hu-coffees) returned only the generic paywall template: 'Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world.' — 0 shipment rows actually displayed on either page (source counter: 2 pages checked, 0 rows seen). Volza, Eximpedia, Trademo returned HTTP 403; ImportGenius returned a JavaScript challenge page. No B/L or customs line could be quoted.
domestic_evidence: Company website https://www.bilihu.in/ states: 'We make coffee that isn't just sought after by some of the best hotels across India' and lists a registered address 'C-22 First Floor, Sector-6 Noida Uttar Pradesh 201301 India' with retail e-commerce pricing (e.g. 'Arabica Blend (Dark Roast) ... ₹749.00 250g'). This is a marketing/self-declaration and an active D2C storefront, not a shipment or GST record. No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract document or annual-report revenue split was found or quoted.
note: Rule 5 applied strictly: no factual shipment evidence found in either direction. Export status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' only because all four trade-data aggregators blocked access (403 / JS challenge) and the search backend was unavailable ('searx: Connection refused'), so absence could not be positively established — it is not a confirmation of any shipment. Domestic side is 'declared_only': the bilihu.in site claims supply to hotels across India and operates a live retail shop, but no GST turnover figure, tender award or contract was located, so the hotel-supply claim remains 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. Declared HS 090111 (green coffee, not roasted) is inconsistent with the observed product line of roasted specialty coffee beans (HS 0901.21 roasted, not decaffeinated) — per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground; the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the actual roasted-coffee heading once a shipment record is obtained. Revenue and export volume: null (not public / not retrieved). No CIN, PAN or LLPIN verified — not invented. Recommended next step: paid Volza/Eximpedia lookup or DGFT/IEC-linked data to obtain a dated B/L before any status upgrade.
